name: Tourist/Visit Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Nationals of a large bilaterally-negotiated exemption list (reported at 67+ countries, including the EU, much of the Gulf, and several African/American/Asian states) may enter visa-free for a limited stay; other nationalities must obtain a visa through a Tunisian consulate before travel -- Tunisia does not yet have a functioning e-visa system as of this build.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for a visa at a Tunisian consulate before travel, if not on the visa-exemption list.

evidence_required.document: Proof of accommodation and return ticket

outcome.duration_length: commonly reported as up to 90 days for the main visa-exempt list; not confirmed against a government source in this build

sources.title: TunisiePromo (private Tunisian travel/news site) -- visa policy overview: reports a bilateral visa-exemption arrangement covering roughly 67+ countries for short stays; separately reports Tunisia is still developing (not yet operating) an electronic visa system as of this build

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Tunisia). STATUS: DRAFT -- this build could not locate a working, fetchable Tunisian government page (Ministry of Interior, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, or a dedicated visa portal) covering visa policy at the level of detail this dataset normally requires; every search returned only private travel-industry or news sites (tier 3/4). This is a genuine, disclosed sourcing gap rather than an assumption that no such page exists -- Tunisia's government web presence was notably harder to locate and fetch in this build than in most other countries built in this dataset, worth a dedicated follow-up attempt. GENUINE STRUCTURAL FINDING: unlike most countries built in this dataset, Tunisia does not yet operate an e-visa system -- a 'projet de visa électronique' is reported as still in development, meaning visa nationals must still apply in person or by post through a consulate.
